services.desc: Your private Tiki Tour of the Chain of Lakes! 3 hours About Enjoy a leisurely cruise in our fun 8 passenger tiki-boat. More info 21 + to book the tour however all ages can be on the boat as long as accompanied by an adult. Boat comes with a licensed Captain!
